text: 农业银行公告，公司收到上海证券交易所出具的审核意见，认为公司向特定对象发行A股股票申请符合发行条件、上市条件和信息披露要求。本次向特定对象发行A股股票事项尚需获得中国证监会作出同意注册的决定后方可实施，最终能否获得同意注册及时间尚存在不确定性。
text_en: Agricultural Bank of China announced that it received a review opinion issued by the Shanghai Stock Exchange, which held that the company's application for a targeted A-share issuance meets the issuance conditions, listing conditions and information disclosure requirements. This targeted A-share issuance still requires a registration decision from the CSRC before implementation, and whether and when registration approval will be obtained remains uncertain.
